skill_name: What is the difference between a Support Vector Machine (SVM) and a Neural Network?
workflow: Support Vector Machines (SVMs) are supervised learning algorithms that can be used for classification and regression tasks. They use a subset of training data, known as support vectors, to create a decision boundary that is used to categorize new data points. Neural Networks are more general-purpose computing systems modeled after the human brain, consisting of interconnected “neurons”.
